title: Water Bubble Flips an Astronaut's Face
description: A floating water sphere aboard Artemis II acts like a liquid lens, flipping an astronaut's face upside down. We break down the refraction, keep NASA's native crew audio, and replay the detail.
Source: NASA, Fun with Water Bubbles (2026-04-04), NASA ID art002m1200950026_SHARED_Returned_0025_Z9_019_Wiseman.
